summary: NB Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Subordinated Note Purchase Agreement on November 6, 2026, issuing $100 million of 7.50% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due 2036 at par to qualified institutional buyers and accredited investors in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. Net proceeds approximate $98.27 million for general corporate purposes, including liquidity, Bank capital support, dividends and share repurchases, with at least $30 million initially contributed to Needham Bank. Interest is fixed at 7.50% semi-annually until November 15, 2031, then resets quarterly at three-month SOFR plus 305 basis points; redemption begins November 15, 2031, subject to regulatory approval. This is routine capital-raising, not a special situation.
